# Kubernetes diagram icons

Artwork: Kubernetes Authors / Kubernetes community.
Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/community/tree/main/icons
Upstream documentation: [original README](./kubernetes-icons-upstream.md).

The upstream icon set offers a choice of Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-4.0.
This project uses the icons under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Original SVG artwork is stored without changes in `../assets/kubernetes/`.
Download date, original paths and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `../assets/kubernetes/manifest.json`.
Size, surrounding state marks and labels are supplied by the teaching interface. In topology view the original artwork is an identity badge attached to a project-authored isometric illustration; in sequence view it remains a flat header symbol.
The Kubernetes logo remains subject to the Linux Foundation's trademark guidelines.

Controller roles share the official controller-manager symbol; Deployment and ReplicaSet
resources have their own resource symbols. EndpointSlice uses the general endpoints
(ep) artwork as a visual family; it is not the legacy Endpoints API object.
Generic Service forwarding uses a separate routing drawing, so it does not imply that
all clusters use kube-proxy. Runtime, terminal, DNS, metrics, checks and documents use
project-authored neutral line symbols, rather than claiming an official icon exists.
